future.vscodeExtension: deferred; design only after browser extension, bridge, schemas, and plugin remain stable

arena.disabledBehavior: normal engine or engine-free startup with no Direct Max starter or per-turn envelope

capabilityVisibility.directTools: always included in list_commands and addressable as server multiscript
capabilityVisibility.specialists: searchable through ms_list_virtual_tools and coordinated by ms_studio_director
capabilityVisibility.nativeCounts: reported separately and never presented as total product capability

engineToolkit.transport: translated onto each engine's own MCP server (Roblox execute_luau, Blender/Unity MCP) or file-native (Godot project files)
engineToolkit.visibleWhen: only for engines with a configured MCP server

terminal.startsBridgeFrom: chat-bar terminal icon via Chrome Native Messaging

studioHub.cowork: shared leased task board with acceptance checks, evidence and blockers
studioHub.recording: max 5 seconds, MJPEG AVI + vision contact sheet
studioHub.codeFlight: dedicated tab; real icon, three worlds, Arcade/Practice, precision score, visibility pause
studioHub.skillActivation: per-project/engine activation, candidates/user-verified, Markdown import and pinned library workflows
studioHub.providerSessions: explicit supported-tab discovery, bounded local briefs, atomic task assignment and acknowledged dispatch receipts
studioHub.mobile: opt-in paired LAN phone remote; task status, queued follow-ups, queue pause/resume and Stop; disabled at boot
studioHub.taskProgress: explicit run-scoped steps, evidence-gated reported completion, blockers and remaining count

ultraManuals.transport: Local ms_ultra_manual; relevance-selected bounded excerpts plus complete six-section methods on demand
ultraManuals.training: In-context instructions, not changes to model weights
ultraManuals.detailTransport: Full or phase-specific read; compact startup/task routing; no new permissions.

figmaCompanion.scope: Paired current page; Read or Edit permission enforced in relay and plugin

providerBenchmarks: 16-provider compatibility evidence, search/current filters and read-only local readiness diagnostics; no invented model ratings

updates.transport: Native Messaging for registered unpacked Dev; browser update service for managed installs
updates.verification: Pinned RSA/SHA-256 signed metadata, archive hash, stable identity and safe managed paths
updates.apply: Explicit idle apply and reload; preserves settings/private data; journaled rollback

blenderWorkspace.backend: Real background Blender 4.5 LTS or compatible installed Blender
blenderWorkspace.portableRuntime: Hash-pinned official Windows x64/ARM64 packages; real native integration tested on Windows x64.
blenderWorkspace.entry: Chatbar cube icon or extension popup → Open Blender Workspace
blenderWorkspace.permissions: Authenticated same-origin loopback UI; normal engine/session boundaries; Python runs with local user permissions.
blenderWorkspace.sessionControls: In-workspace Multi-Script panel: provider selection, task steps, context-checked follow-up queue, Stop and settings
blenderWorkspace.companion: Explicit per-engine opt-in prepares/resumes the same real Blender project before starting a connected Roblox/Unity/Godot session.
blenderWorkspace.materialPreview: Local studio IBL plus cached procedural base-color texture baking; native shaders remain intact. Exact effects/lighting require a Blender render.
blenderWorkspace.persistence: Native .blend saved before preview export; stopped-worker snapshot/preview restored from disk with a Resume Blender control.
blenderWorkspace.handoff: Validated Unity FBX / Godot GLB project-folder copy or pinned Roblox GLB download. Existing assets require explicit overwrite. Import verification remains a separate engine operation.
